children: fell 0.49% in premarket after the company reported fiscal fourth-quarter net sales up 11.2% to $93.9 billion and diluted earnings per share of $6.75, up from $5.87 a year earlier. The 16-week quarter included a one-time benefit of $0.15 a share from IEEPA tariff refunds, net of partial reinvestment in member value.

Total company comparable sales rose 9.4%, but just 6.7% excluding the effects of gasoline prices and foreign exchange. U.S. comps rose 10.7%, or 7.2% adjusted, while Canada lagged at 4.6% adjusted. Digitally enabled sales grew 19.5%. Membership fee income rose to $1.85 billion from $1.72 billion.

For the full year, net sales rose 10.1% to $297.2 billion and EPS reached $20.76, up from $18.21. Costco ended the year with $20.2 billion in cash and equivalents, up from $14.2 billion, and 939 warehouses worldwide.

title: Costco Shares Slip After 11% Jump in Quarterly Sales
